host.title: Hub host
host.description: Hostname or IP of the PowerView hub.

refreshShades.title: Refresh on read
refreshShades.description: Request fresh shade positions from the hub on every HomeKit read.

pollShadesForUpdate.title: Poll every 30 seconds
pollShadesForUpdate.description: Periodically poll the hub for shade position updates.

strictErrors.title: Strict errors
strictErrors.description: When enabled, HomeKit reads fail on hub errors instead of returning the last known position.

healSweepIntervalMinutes.title: Check all shades every (minutes)
healSweepIntervalMinutes.description: 0 is off, the default. Otherwise, read every shade over RF at this interval (at least 30 minutes), one at a time, so moves made with a physical remote or the PowerView app show up in HomeKit. Each read wakes a motor; sweeps are skipped during quiet hours. 720 (twice a day) is a reasonable start.

healSweepGapMs.title: Pause between shades (ms)
healSweepGapMs.description: Pause after each shade in a sweep, so the hub and radio handle one shade at a time.

batteryPolling.title: Daily battery poll
batteryPolling.description: Off by default. When enabled, refreshes shade battery levels once a day. Each poll wakes every shade motor over RF: it is audible and nudges the shade, so do not schedule it near sleeping hours. Battery level still reaches HomeKit from ordinary hub reads without this.

batteryPollAt.title: Battery poll time
batteryPollAt.description: Local time of day (HH:MM) for the daily battery poll.

syncPositionsOnStart.title: Sync positions at startup
syncPositionsOnStart.description: Re-read shade positions over RF once when the plugin starts, for shades the hub has no position for. Wakes those motors briefly. Without it, a shade moved by remote can show a stale position indefinitely.

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.description: Local-time window in which the plugin will not actuate hardware. Applies to the startup position sync, so an unattended overnight restart stays silent. Set both to the same hour to disable.

forceRollerShades.title: Force roller shade IDs
forceRollerShades.description: Treat these shade IDs as roller shades regardless of hub type.

requestIntervalMs.title: Hub request spacing (ms)
requestIntervalMs.description: Delay between requests to the hub, which answers one at a time. Lowering it feels faster but a legacy hub drops connections when commands arrive too quickly — 25ms was tried and lost shades from group moves. Raise it if your hub returns errors or truncated responses under load.

exposeScenes.title: Expose hub scenes as switches
exposeScenes.description: Publish each PowerView scene as a HomeKit switch. Activating one is a single hub call that moves the whole group together, which individual shade commands cannot match. Nothing appears if you have no scenes defined in the PowerView app.

excludeScenes.title: Hide these scenes
excludeScenes.description: Scenes to keep out of HomeKit, such as ones that exist only for a physical remote. Enter the name as the PowerView app shows it (case-insensitive) or the numeric hub scene ID. A scene already in HomeKit is removed.

sceneNamePrefix.title: Scene name prefix
sceneNamePrefix.description: Text put in front of each scene switch's name, so scenes are easy to tell apart from shades in the Home app. Applies to scenes added from now on; existing switches keep their names.

reportTravel.title: Animate shade travel in HomeKit
reportTravel.description: Off by default: the tile shows the position you asked for as soon as you tap, which is responsive but is ahead of the shade while it moves. Turn on to keep the tile on the real position and show opening/closing during travel — truer, but the number does not change for several seconds.
